'''Kroius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] of a [[Quesh]] chemical refinery during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was approached by [[Cipher Nine]], who requested from him the access to [[Dimalium-6]].
